notes.subject: tsedeke ya gagwe
notes.rationale: צדקו — tsedeke ya Yahwe (geneva, jps) kapa ya motho yo a šomišwago (ketelo ya sebiši, KJV); sephuthingwe.

notes.subject: go godiša
notes.rationale: Seheberu se na le infinitive leinao fela; go dira ga lentšu le ile la oketšwa go hlaka.

notes.subject: יגדיל/ויאדיר
notes.rationale: Ditlhaka tša gadal–adar di aga parallelism ya go godiša/go tlotlisa; sebopego se a lahlwa ka Sepedi.

translation: Yahwe o ile a kgahla, ka baka la tsedeke ya ⟨gagwe⟩, go godiša ⟨את⟩ Torah gomme go e tlotlisa.
